title: WAZID SPAMMER
features:
😈 WAZID SPAMMER 🗿🔥
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
A premium, highly customizable chat spammer featuring a stunning Blood Moon UI, multi-recipient targeting, built-in message editor, and RX Chat integration.

⚠️ THIS SCRIPT USES A KEY SYSTEM

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

✦ KEY SYSTEM — HOW TO GET YOUR KEY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
1. Execute the script in your executor.
2. The Blood Moon Key prompt will appear.
3. Click the "🌐 GET KEY" button to copy the official Key Generator URL to your clipboard.
4. Paste the URL into your browser and complete the quick verification to generate your key.
5. Paste the key into the script's prompt and click "✅ VERIFY".
6. Once verified, the main UI will load! (Keys have a max of 4 uses).

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

✦ FEATURES
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
✅ Blood Moon UI — A sleek, dark-red animated interface with a custom 3-second loading screen.
✅ Chat Spammer — Customizable Target, Symbol formatting (default @), Character Count, and Interval Speed.
✅ MULTI-TARGET (10 Slots) — Type up to 10 targets. The script automatically detects filled slots and cycles through them.
✅ MESSAGE EDITOR — Add, edit, delete, and save your custom messages. Saves to your executor's files (wazid_messages.json).
✅ RX CHAT INTEGRATION — One-click button to fetch and execute the RX Chat script.
✅ Draggable UI — Move the window anywhere and minimize it to a floating 🗿 button.
✅ TextChatService & Legacy Chat — Works across all Roblox games.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

✦ NOTE FOR MODERATORS (Please Read)
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
This script utilizes a custom Key System. Here is how the code operates:
1. `HttpService` / `syn.request`: Used EXCLUSIVELY to validate the user's key against our secure database and increment the usage counter. No personal data is collected.
2. `loadstring`: Used EXCLUSIVELY for the optional "RX Chat" button (fetching from the official GitHub URL provided in the script).
3. `writefile` / `readfile`: Used to save the user's custom chat messages locally so they persist between sessions.
There are no hidden payloads, token loggers, or malicious remote calls in this code.
